Full Body Dumbbell Routine

A complete full-body routine using dumbbells to target shoulders, chest, triceps, back, biceps, legs, and core. Perform 3 sets of 8–12 repetitions per exercise for balanced strength and muscle development.

20–25 min
Duration
7
Exercises
1 Circuit (7 Exercises)
Blocks
Beginner Dumbbells Yoga Mat
0 of 7 done

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Dumbbell Lateral Raises

3 × 8–12 reps
ShouldersLateral Deltoids
  • Raise dumbbells out to shoulder level with controlled tempo
  • Keep a soft bend in the elbows and avoid momentum

Why: Builds lateral deltoid strength and shoulder width.

02

Dumbbell Floor Press

3 × 8–12 reps
ChestTricepsShoulders
  • Keep upper arms angled around 45 degrees from torso
  • Press dumbbells upward until arms are fully extended

Why: Strengthens chest and pushing muscles safely from the floor.

03

Single Arm Overhead Extension

3 × 8–12 reps
Triceps
  • Keep elbow pointing forward and upward
  • Extend the weight smooth and lower under control

Why: Isolates and strengthens the triceps through an overhead range of motion.

04

Dumbbell Bent Over Rows

3 × 8–12 reps
Upper BackLatsBiceps
  • Hinge forward at hips keeping a flat back spine
  • Drive elbows back toward hips and squeeze shoulder blades

Why: Targets pulling strength and reinforces back posture.

05

Dumbbell Bicep Curls

3 × 8–12 reps
BicepsForearms
  • Keep elbows pinned near sides
  • Curl weight smoothly upward without swaying torso

Why: Develops bicep strength and arm stability.

06

Dumbbell Forward Lunges

3 × 8–12 reps
QuadricepsGlutesHamstrings
  • Step forward smoothly and lower rear knee toward floor
  • Keep chest upright and push back through front heel

Why: Builds single-leg strength, balance, and leg stability.

07

Dumbbell Crunches

3 × 8–12 reps
AbsCore
  • Hold dumbbell above chest
  • Engage core to curl upper back off floor without neck strain

Why: Adds weighted resistance to enhance abdominal core strength.

Trainer Tips

  • Maintain controlled execution and avoid using body momentum during lifting motions.
  • Rest 60–90 seconds between sets to maintain high performance across all 3 sets.
